professionalSummary: Owned the delivery division's cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) for two and a half years, deciding and executing production infrastructure changes as the named platform owner.
Kept the Terraform code, deployment pipelines for the tracking and dispatch services, and cost controls (account budgets, tagging policy, monthly right‑sizing pass) in shape.
Chaired the fortnightly change board with four service team leads, deciding production window contents and keeping minutes.
Worked changes through with service teams and finance, recording decisions on configuration, budget approval, and platform ownership in the minutes.
